shared_elements: human figure rendered in low relief
sets of parallel incised lines forming bands
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow, schematic relief carving that includes a prominent circular disc, a human head/face, arms and hands, and areas of ruled parallel lines, which is the most specific correspondence available. But A is a single frontal anthropomorphic body with motifs distributed over its own back and shoulders (disc at centre, arms curving round, banded chest), while B presents a lateral narrative-like scene of profile heads and a standing figure beside a framed panel; the relationships and layout of the elements have almost nothing in common.
